name: Guardian: Line Formation's stance returns when a creature's charm ends (#13855)
contract: #13855: a Guardian charmed by Jammal'an the Prophet (Hex of Jammal'an 12483, MOD_CHARM, 15 s) came back without
their formation bar. Line Formation 803130 stays on the Guardian, but its helper 803151 is a shapeshift aura, and
Unit::SetCharmedBy strips every shapeshift aura from a charmed player. Nothing put the helper back, so the
formation was active with none of its effects or bar. The Guardian takes Line Formation in the Temple of
Atal'Hakkar, Jammal'an is summoned and forced to cast 12483 on them with '.cast back' after a native selection,
as in the Manastorm Jammal'an charm scenario. While charmed the helper is gone; once the charm ends the helper
must be back with the formation still active.

steps.label: CONTROL: the formation survives the teleport
Let the boss's spawn events settle
Jammal'an's out-of-combat immune-to-PC window has cleared
CONTROL: Jammal'an's Hex charms the Guardian
CONTROL: the charm strips the stance helper
The charm ends after its 15 s
DISCRIMINATING: Line Formation's stance helper is back after the charm
Line Formation itself is still active
